purpose: SP13 E cell: the SP12 spike-triggered gate (KsAHP) with a 5 s tail at one dose fixed from the SP12 traces. Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-12-h01-e-sahp-tail.md.
executor_note: Runs on the Vast.ai box (NEURON 9.0.2, Python 3.12 venv); kv3-closing-source library at the SP12 recompile with KsAHP.mod.
image: braintrace-h01-neuron:9.0.2 (reference image; not used by the local executor; it lacks KsAHP)
holdout: Sweep 54 (330 pA) is sealed (h01_l2_sweep_export.SEALED) and is not an input of any stage. Sweep 55 (350 pA) was opened by the usable campaign and is not rerun here.
evaluation: One parameter set at its stage's inputs; one evaluation = serial runs in one process.

base_candidate.note: SP12 dose A; this candidate changes tau_off 1000 to 5000 ms and the density 3.4968e-4 to 3.12e-4 S/cm2.

0.title: Stage 0: KsAHP with tau_off 5000 ms at sweep 56 (200 pA)
0.prediction: Count 1-2; late-pulse and mid-pulse p50 within 1 mV of the human (-67.06 and -67.47 mV; derived prediction -67.06 and -67.43 mV); the trace before B3's first spike unchanged within 0.1 mV and the first spike within 1 ms of 1147.2 ms; axon-first. Reported: every 100 ms p50 from 1240 to 2000 ms within 1 mV of the human.
0.rejection: Any band fails: the family is closed at this gate shape for tails of 1 to 5 s and stage 1 is not opened.
0.unchanged: All SP12 dose-A flags except the two named; nseg factor 9, CVode 1e-10, recorded command plus bias, stop 2100 ms, record_soma_currents.

1.title: Stage 1: the same candidate at sweeps 50, 53 and 43 (250, 310, 110 pA)
1.prediction: 250 pA: count 5-7 with cycles 4-5 of 250-350 ms. 310 pA: count 9-10 with late cycles within 12.8 ms of 120 ms. 110 pA: every sweep-43 onset row (1019-1120 ms) within 1 mV of the human and within 0.1 mV of g0-b3.
1.rejection: The 310 pA count falls below 9, or any sweep-43 row moves by 0.1 mV or more against g0-b3, or the 250 pA count leaves 5-7.
